title: The 1905 Nobel citation credits Koch for his tuberculosis work
summary: The Nobel Foundation credits Robert Koch for his investigations and discoveries in relation to tuberculosis.
body: The Nobel Prize API record for 1905 says Robert Koch received the prize in physiology or medicine for his investigations and discoveries in relation to tuberculosis. The record dates the award 12 October 1905. Current WHO estimates of cases and deaths are a different card.

sources.title: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 1905
sources.author: Nobel Foundation
sources.note: Motivation text was read from the Nobel Prize API record.
